articles.mainIdea: American Financial Group, Inc. Announces 2025 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results and Declares Special Dividend
articles.summary: Business Wire: American Financial Group, Inc. Announces 2025 Fourth Quarter and Full Year Results and Declares Special Dividend. CINCINNATI, February 03, 2026--American Financial Group, Inc. (NYSE: AFG) today reported 2025 fourth quarter net earnings of $299 million ($3.58 per share) compared to $255 million ($3.03 per share) in the 2024 fourth quarter. Net earnings for the 2025 fourth quarter included net after-tax non-core realized losses of $6 million ($0.07 per share loss).
